author: Michael Larabel
description: FreeBSD 14.4 is out today as the latest update to the aging FreeBSD 14 series for those not yet ready to upgrade to FreeBSD 15 that debuted as stable last year...
title: FreeBSD 14.4 Released For Those Not Yet Ready To Move To FreeBSD 15

author: Michael Larabel
description: Last week was a statement by System76 regarding recent age verification laws in California and Colorado among other US states that could have a profound impact on Linux distributions and other open-source software. The Colorado legislation is especially pressing to System76 considering that is where they are based.  Fortunately, they aren't taking this lightly and there is some hope that at least in Colorado open-source software could be excluded...
title: There's Hope That At Least Colorado's Age Attestation Bill Could Exclude Open-Source

author: Michael Larabel
description: With CUDA 13.2 that is now shipping, NVIDIA has provided official support for Red Hat Enterprise Linux compatible distributions/downstreams like AlmaLinux to CUDA. With this official NVIDIA CUDA support for these RHEL-compatible distributions, NVIDIA is also allowing the NVIDIA packages to be distributed directly from the OS package repositories...
title: NVIDIA Adds Official Support For RHEL-Compatible Distributions Like AlmaLinux With CUDA 13.2

author: Michael Larabel
description: Intel just published the XeSS 3.0 SDK to GitHub as the newest version of their Xe Super Sampling AI-enhanced upscaling technology for gamers. Sadly though it remains proprietary software and only with native support for Windows...
title: Intel Publishes XeSS 3 SDK To GitHub - Still As Windows-Only Binaries

author: Michael Larabel
description: A set of patches posted to the Linux kernel mailing list last week introduce a new driver for enhancing the upstream/mainline Linux kernel support for Synology network attached storage (NAS) devices. This new driver is Synology Microp and is making use of the Linux kernel's modern Rust programming language support...
title: New Rust Driver Aims To Improve Upstream Linux On Synology NAS Devices

author: Michael Larabel
description: Richard Biener of SUSE published a new status report on the state of GCC 16 development. Regression fixing has been going slow but they are hoping to publish a release candidate by mid-April...
title: GCC 16 Compiler Aiming For Mid-April Release Candidate But "Slow" Progress On Fixes

author: Michael Larabel
description: Rust Coreutils 0.7 released on Sunday as a performance-focused update to this popular alternative to GNU Coreutils that is still striving for 100% compatibility against the GNU Test Suite...
title: Rust Coreutils 0.7 Released With Many Performance Optimizations
